confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are rough. No Essaouira-specific menu prices were found, so they rest on Morocco-wide and Marrakech, Casablanca and Rabat price points, one Mohammedia cappuccino figure, and dated guides. Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer: cocktail at about twice the beer price, and wine glass from tourist-restaurant and hotel reference points. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not checked against live listings or current rates. The FX observation is the latest RBA value I could retrieve, dated 2026-03-20. It came from a search-result snippet of the RBA page, which I did not open, and it is well before the 2026-10-16 generation date. Overall confidence is low.
comparable_city_reasoning: No Essaouira-specific restaurant survey was found. Restaurant and drink anchors use Morocco-wide guidance with Marrakech, Rabat and Casablanca as proxies, adjusted for Essaouira as a small coastal tourist town. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a small coastal Moroccan resort town in peak summer season.
